rationale: Always Encrypted 缺失直接阻塞敏感列客户端加密；后续 provider 交付有阶段性限制但原问题被项目方认定解决。
observation: .NET Core SqlClient最初不识别Column Encryption Setting，也不支持SQL Server Always Encrypted，阻塞企业对敏感列的客户端加密并迫使项目退回.NET Framework、自建加密或采用ODBC双连接变通。长期讨论把该缺口与GDPR和企业安全要求关联；Microsoft.Data.SqlClient preview后来提供Always Encrypted，但经历reference API遗漏、EF Core尚未切换provider及Azure Key Vault custom provider未适配等阶段性限制，最终原始问题被认定解决。
scope_note: 材料跨两年并混合多个版本、provider和用户配置问题；最终关闭只确认原始能力已在Microsoft.Data.SqlClient中提供，不代表所有EF Core、Key Vault或具体使用案例均同时解决。

rationale: 讨论区分普通 fingerprint、SHA-256、HMAC 与真正匿名化；交付的 processor 明确不是匿名化。
observation: 提案以GDPR匿名化为理由增加fingerprint processor，但讨论厘清了内容指纹与敏感数据匿名化的不同安全目标：普通SHA-256便于从内容重算，在低熵或已知输入下可暴力枚举；HMAC可降低枚举风险，却要求所有ingest nodes使用一致secret key，且知晓密钥仍可重识别，因此更接近pseudonymization。最终交付的fingerprint processor明确不用于匿名化，匿名化能力另案跟踪。

rationale: 邮件打开统计受客户端阻止 pixel 影响，并把点击反推为打开，属于跟踪测量语义而非纯实测。
observation: Gophish无法稳定记录只打开邮件的个人，因为许多邮件客户端为隐私阻止tracking pixels；系统在记录link click时会反向补写Email Opened，因为点击逻辑上意味着曾打开。这使open统计同时包含像素实测与点击推断事件，而非纯粹的独立打开观测。
scope_note: 邮件模板含个人签名和privacy notice，但问题核心是tracking pixel事件语义；材料未说明报表是否标记backfilled events，可能造成用户误读统计。

rationale: 经分析静态无 cookie 站点当时无需 notice；初始合规担忧被缩小为网站性质变化时再评估。
observation: NewPipe 网站最初担心德国和欧洲法律要求 imprint、外链免责声明，并提出讨论 cookies。详细法律分析认为该非商业、纯信息静态站点不使用 cookie，除合法 webserver logs 外不收集需告知的个人数据，因此当时不需要 imprint、免责声明或隐私告知；若网站性质改变则需重新评估。
scope_note: The legal reasoning is a participant's analysis and linked statutes/blog posts were not fetched. It describes the site at that time; later changes in data collection, commercial character, law, or jurisdiction could alter the conclusion.

scope_note: Linked subissues and PRs were not fetched, so the scope and completeness of implemented masking cannot be verified. The discussion contains expert guidance rather than authoritative legal advice and recognizes that workload-specific PII can escape generic infrastructure rules.

observation: Scripture Burrito 规范原本要求在元数据中记录制作者或上传者姓名与系统内标识。讨论确认这些信息对追溯归档过程有用途，但姓名和不透明 ID 都可能直接或间接识别自然人，从而给跨境传输、第三方共享和同意带来 GDPR 负担。最终共识是用户信息“有时需要、但应可选”，并可在导出时剥离，而不是从规范中一律删除。
scope_note: The discussion reaches a policy-level consensus, but the frozen record does not show the resulting schema change, defaults, consent mechanism, or implementation of export stripping. Participants explicitly note legal uncertainty and ecosystem-dependent processing contexts.

observation: Guppy 为了解使用量和功能优先级新增事件分析，因 Google 的跨站跟踪而改选 Mixpanel，并用服务抽象降低未来更换供应商的成本。项目声称不收集 PII，为安装生成并本地保存随机 UUID，明确认为这比读取 MAC 等设备标识侵入性低；分析代码与事件调用已完成，但清单中的 Privacy Policy 尚未完成，也未讨论用户同意或退出。
scope_note: The issue does not enumerate every tracked event/property or include the final privacy policy, retention, access, consent, or opt-out design. A persistent random UUID can still support longitudinal linkage even if the developers do not classify it as PII.

rationale: 敏感政治言论匿名发布依赖 null-authority 账户，仍有链上与限流权衡；前端易用能力未交付。
observation: Steem 用户要求让单个帖子或评论不留作者记录，以保护发表敏感社会政治言论者，并指出普通账户只是可串联全部行为的假名。维护者说明链上已有任何人可用的 null-authority 账户，可无签名发帖；完全无账户作者会失去基于 Steem Power 的限流并形成攻击面。报告者接受该机制可用，但认为仍应在前端或 API 做成更易用的匿名发布功能。
scope_note: The issue establishes an available workaround and design tradeoff, but no new frontend/API implementation is shown. Network, timing, content, or off-chain metadata may still permit attribution; the discussion only addresses author records and account authority on the blockchain.

rationale: OIDC 存储层可替换为内存对象以避免持久 PII；这是扩展能力说明，不是默认存储泄露证据。
observation: OIDC 客户端对 browser window、localStorage 和 sessionStorage 的假设妨碍同构 React，并引出允许完全不使用浏览器持久存储以减少 PII 留存的请求。维护者说明存储层已经可扩展：实现 WebStorageStateStore API 并在 UserManagerSettings 中指定 userStore，即可接入简单内存对象。该条是存储可替换性说明，不是证据表明默认存储泄露了 PII。
scope_note: The issue does not enumerate what identity/token fields are stored, their lifetime, or whether the requester successfully implemented the isomorphic setup. The response describes an API capability rather than a verified privacy configuration.

observation: OpenDota 用户提议按字段隐藏个人资料数据，但维护者拒绝服务器端随机缺字段的隐私控制，理由是会增加 API 使用复杂度。替代方式是让用户在游戏客户端关闭 Expose Public Match Data，使收集到的数据不再链接到其账户；颜色和布局定制则转交 UI。该方案是账户关联层的匿名化，而非停止数据收集。
scope_note: The issue does not define whether retained match data can be relinked through other identifiers or validate the client's anonymization behavior. It also does not show a new privacy feature being implemented; the proposed server-side controls were declined.

rationale: 输出层截断 IPv4/IPv6 并可调强度，但原始日志仍保留完整地址且功能非默认。
observation: GoAccess 用户希望公开统计报告时隐藏访问者 IP，尤其是 Tor、Tails 等敏感项目；讨论还指出 referral URL 也可能含敏感信息。最终加入 IPv4/IPv6 匿名化，将地址在输出层截断以保留准确的访客统计，并提供不同强度参数；由于处理仅在输出层，原始存储仍保留完整地址。该功能不是默认开启，后续用户仍需显式传入 anonymize-ip，旧版本也不支持较新的 level 参数。
scope_note: The issue reports implementation and later usage, but code and generated reports were not inspected. Output-only masking does not establish deletion or protection of raw logs, and truncation may retain varying re-identification risk depending on network size and auxiliary data.

scope_note: The exchange is a threat-model and protocol-design discussion, not an executed exploit or formal proof. rationale: 导出默认用数字索引替换 worker ID，但生产库仍可识别且 no-scrub 可显式导出原 ID。

rationale: ASVS 把导出与删除误写成 OR，讨论明确两项权利独立且可经 help desk 执行，不要求必须自助 UI。
observation: OWASP ASVS 8.3.2 把“删除或导出用户数据”写成 OR，可能让实现者二选一，但数据可携权和删除权解决不同问题。讨论倾向拆成两个要求或改为 AND，并澄清界面自助并非必要：用户可通过 help desk 发起，但应用仍必须存在可执行导出和删除用户相关数据的方法或程序。是否属于应用验证而非业务流程曾有争议，最终参与者认为仍应保留。
scope_note: The discussion expresses consensus directions but does not include the resulting PR or final ASVS text. Legal statements are participant interpretations, and the exact verification level and whether both verbs became mandatory are not proven by this snapshot.

observation: Ushahidi 认为从 Twitter 数据源保存的推文内容不应继续保留，被遗忘权优先于保存数据的利益。拟通过全局 migration 清空 tweet messages，在 post content 与原推文完全相同时清空内容，并把完全匹配的标题替换为只含来源和日期的文本；还需通知现有数据源用户，并考虑对新部署完全禁用 Twitter。讨论确认方向和沟通要求，但没有合并、迁移执行或通知完成证据。

rationale: 随机 UUID 假名化需持久 value→ID 映射才能保持关联，Beats 无法拆事件且功能最终未实现。
observation: Filebeat 用户想用随机 UUID 替换个人字段并把原值—假名映射放入单独 identity index，以降低字典攻击稳定哈希的风险。讨论澄清随机 UUID 本身不由字段内容决定：若相同原值要跨事件保持同一假名，必须维护 concrete value→random ID 查找表并持久化/清理；否则每个事件不同 UUID 会失去关联和聚合能力。Beats processor 当时不能拆分一个事件为身份与事件两条，Logstash 更适合该流程；功能最终在 backlog grooming 时关闭，未实现。

scope_note: Related issues, referenced guidelines, and any later MDS changes were not fetched. The artifact documents a threat analysis and proposals; a README link does not demonstrate effective anonymization, consent capture, minimum thresholds, or enforcement by cities.

rationale: TURN-TLS 主要解决严格防火墙穿透而非已有明文媒体泄露；协议随机选择仍使 TLS-only 支持不完整。
observation: Nextcloud Talk 最初只返回 TURN 的 UDP/TCP URL，缺少 TURN-TLS/DTLS，导致在仅允许 TLS 443 且做深度包检测的企业或公共网络上无法穿透。长讨论澄清 WebRTC 音视频本已端到端加密，TURN shared secret 通过 HMAC 生成临时凭据而不直接传输，因此 TURNS 通常是额外加密开销而非主要保密增益；核心用途是伪装成 HTTPS 通过严格防火墙。PR 5086 最终允许配置 turn/turns 并测试了 TLS-only 443，但多个服务器随机选择可能使必须用 TURNS 的客户端选到其他协议，故被参与者称为部分修复并转向新 issue。
scope_note: The referenced PRs, RFCs, client implementations, and successor issue were not fetched. The record supports implementation of basic TURNS configuration and a known multi-server reliability limitation; it should not be treated as proof of GDPR compliance or as a confidentiality vulnerability in existing WebRTC media.

scope_note: Screenshots and related issues were not fetched, and no API response was tested. The comments support existence of a precision feature but also acknowledge crude masking; re-identification risk, latitude effects, defaults, and stability across releases remain unverified.

rationale: 旧浏览器 polyfill 显示 banner 却不保存 consent；IE11 有用户复测，IE10/11 有项目声明，IE9 仍不确定。
observation: Klaro cookie consent manager 的常规构建在 IE9–11、旧 Android/iOS 缺少 Map、Symbol、Set、dataset 等能力。早期 IE11 polyfill 虽能显示 banner，却未保存 Klaro consent cookie，导致每次刷新 banner 重现且所有 apps 被勾选。PR 124 后被用户确认在 IE11 可用；另一个 fork 修改 dataset 访问后称可到 IE9。项目最终称已做必要修改以兼容 IE10/11，IE9 仅标为可能。
scope_note: Pull requests, forks, builds, browser matrices, app activation behavior, and production deployments were not inspected. The thread confirms participant tests and a maintainer compatibility claim but not whether checked apps executed before valid consent, whether IE9 works, or later regressions.

scope_note: The Glean instructions, iOS issue, implementation, telemetry backend, deletion timing, and closed-state reason were not inspected. The issue states intended compliance behavior but does not prove the secondary ID was shipped, historical records were deleted, or future telemetry was technically prevented.

rationale: 讨论链上遗忘、链下个人数据、hash 假名化与 ZKP，但迁 Jira 后无产品合规结论。
observation: Hyperledger Indy 用户询问团队是否系统评估过 GDPR。维护者说一般 blockchain 与 GDPR 已广泛讨论，但不知道有专门说明 Indy 或 Sovrin 如何满足要求的论文，只认为其用户管理数据共享方式有优势。另一参与者把不可变账本上的 right to erasure 视为最大挑战，主张个人数据留在链下、链上仅放 verifier，并认为简单 hash 是 pseudonymization 而非 anonymization、ZKP 更适合。后续讨论迁到 Jira，未得出产品合规结论。
scope_note: The linked papers, working-group discussions, Jira ticket, Indy architecture, and legal sources were not inspected. The technical/legal statements are participant views, not an audit; no deployed data flow, erasure test, controller allocation, or jurisdiction-specific compliance is established.

scope_note: No schema, code, release note, geographic granularity, linked records, backups, free text, deletion schedule, or runtime result was inspected. Retaining location combinations may remain identifying, so the described field transformation is not proof of legal anonymization.

observation: Firefox Screenshots 的按钮把上传到 Mozilla 服务器标为 Save，而真正只保存在本机的动作标为 Download，导致用户误以为本地保存并意外上传，尤其可能包含后台或管理页面等敏感截图。维护者确认 Save 会上传、Download 不会；上传截图进入在线 library，默认保存两周，可主动删除或延长。上传禁用偏好 extensions.screenshots.upload-disabled 被称为 Nightly 已有并将在 Firefox 60 发布；团队后来接受命名会让人感觉受骗并讨论 PR 4963。维护者还称用户 ID 是随机 UUID、shot URL 含随机 slug、删除是永久的、开发者无生产数据库访问而运维可维护或删违法内容。但 Firefox 66 用户仍报告上传按钮显示 Save，说明命名修复至少并非所有观察环境均生效。

rationale: 主持人强制解除静音会暴露麦克风，最终采用 ask-to-unmute 并由参与者主动选择，有实现声明但未运行测试。
observation: Jitsi Meet 主持人需要帮助不熟悉技术的参与者解除静音，但直接强制解除可能让未察觉的人突然 on air。请求的设计不是 force-unmute，而是主持人发送醒目的居中提示，由参与者明确选择 Unmute 或 Stay muted，并可短时抑制重复提示。讨论也提出 push-to-talk、快捷键和培训替代方案；有人为远程教学主张主持人强制解除并用加入时告知与视觉指示缓解，但原提出者坚持主动选择。最终评论确认主持人现可在 participants pane 中 ask to unmute。
scope_note: The implementation, prompt UI, authorization, rate limiting, mobile support, accessibility, and audio state transitions were not tested. The closing comment supports availability of ask-to-unmute, not every proposed overlay detail or protection against abusive repeated requests.

rationale: T&C/隐私勾选循环源于 cookie 自动阻断脚本，属于两个同意组件的环境特定兼容冲突。
observation: CiviCRM GDPR extension 的 Terms & Conditions 在贡献/活动注册页曾无法保存、不可见，或用户勾选 Privacy 与 T&C 后仍被重复判为必填，导致无法继续。维护者在最新版不能复现；针对一个 WordPress 安装调试发现前端未登录页面的 T&C block 落在 form 外且 CiviCRM scripts 被剥离。最终根因是 EU Cookie Law 插件启用 Auto Block，在用户同意 cookies 前按配置阻止所有脚本；先接受弹窗并刷新可恢复，用户暂时关闭 Auto Block。该记录因此是两个隐私/同意组件之间的集成冲突，不是已证明的 GDPR extension 核心缺陷修复。
scope_note: Screenshots, the affected site, themes, plugin code, and other installations were not inspected. Diagnosis was confirmed for one setup; the earlier report may have differed, and disabling Auto Block may re-enable scripts the site owner expected to suppress before consent.

rationale: 从 token 移除 email 的最小化设计使 /userinfo 崩溃；改用 user_id 判断有修复 commit 声明。
observation: Cloud Foundry UAA 配置可从 JWT access token 排除 user_name 和 email，以避免 token 携带 PII，并希望资源服务器需要时再经 /userinfo 获取。但无 email 的 token 调用 /userinfo 会因 principal 未创建而产生 500/NPE；代码把 email 是否存在错误地当作 user token 判据。维护者确认是 bug 并提交修复，后续说明以 user_id 的存在判断 user token，而 sub 在 client credentials 场景可能是 client_id。
scope_note: The commit, tests, release version, token payloads, and /userinfo authorization were not inspected. The thread supports a reported code fix and design explanation, not deployment verification or proof that all PII was excluded from tokens and protected at the endpoint.

observation: GlobaLeaks 上传文件可能含 JPG GPS、文档作者等元数据，使举报者被记者、被查扣设备或取证分析去匿名化，而界面当时缺乏明确提示。项目明确选择不在上传时自动 scrub、杀毒或分析：解析复杂格式会扩大 RCE 攻击面，无法确保清除所有格式，也无法自动区分暴露举报人的元数据与证明受害者/行为人的证据元数据。平台默认 15 天删除提交数据；启用 PGP 时服务器存密文，未启用会警告明文。讨论转向用通俗威胁后果改写警告、让接收方负责清理，并研究显示识别出的元数据、由用户选择删除或由管理员强制最大移除；没有实现客户端自动净化。
scope_note: Tails tools, PGP configuration, warning changes, FAQ, print-based safe mode, research features, file handling, and retention deletion were not independently inspected. The record documents threat reasoning and intended warnings; it does not prove users understood them, recipients scrubbed files, or any format became metadata-free.

scope_note: The implementation, defaults, cookie storage mechanism, legal sources, browser behavior, and deployed sites were not inspected. Configurability is reported by the requester, while the legal six-month premise remains disputed and may be jurisdiction-specific.

rationale: 远程图片自动 HEAD 会向发送者暴露接收者 IP，默认禁用且 opt-in 偏好只在 OS X beta 有声明。
observation: Monal 当时故意不自动内联显示聊天图片，而只显示链接，因为检测在线图片会对每个 URL 自动发 HTTP HEAD；恶意发送者可给单个接收者唯一 URL，在其仅收到消息、未点击时从服务器日志得到 IP 并推断位置。XMPP 双方通常只连接服务器，因此不会必然互知 IP；手动点击至少让接收者知道发生外部连接。维护者计划仅以 opt-in 提供内联，后来称已在最新 OS X beta 加入偏好，测试后才会带到 iOS。
scope_note: The beta, HTTP request behavior, proxying, caching, image host, iOS release, OMEMO, and current clients were not tested. The threat description is technically plausible and explicit, while only the OS X beta opt-in is claimed implemented in this record.

scope_note: Extension versions, Firefox permissions, review feedback, actual network requests during the temporary disable, and the duplicate notice issue were not inspected. The record supports removal of the control after 2.0, not whether any users' browsing was tracked or later notice was shipped.

observation: phpMyAdmin 4.8.0 起大量环境出现 Failed to set session cookie / HTTP instead of HTTPS 错误并无法登录；同一提示覆盖多个根因，包括先经 HTTPS 设置 secure cookie 后切回 HTTP（浏览器正确地不发送 secure cookie）、session 过期/token 失效、错误 cookie path/PmaAbsoluteUri、代理或路径配置、TraceKit/JS 异常，以及浏览器扩展拦截 js.cookie.js 或改写 Set-Cookie。部分建议通过关闭安全检查、修改 token mismatch 或 secure 选项绕过，但维护者认为降低 secure cookie 不理想。提交的修复进入 4.9.2，对部分用户有效、部分仍失败；团队明确称一些情形已解决但仍有 edge cases，转到 #15634。该材料是认证/session cookie 兼容与安全配置问题，不是 cookie notice、跟踪同意或已确认个人数据泄露。
scope_note: The patches, successor issues, browser extensions, server configurations, security impact of workarounds, and phpMyAdmin runtime were not independently tested. The thread combines heterogeneous failures, so neither the 4.9.2 fix nor any single root cause explains all reports; no evidence establishes a privacy disclosure.

scope_note: The Android Geocoder provider, network traffic, coordinates2country accuracy, PR, merged state, release, and actual coordinate precision were not inspected. Third-party transmission is stated as possible, not demonstrated for every device or backend.

scope_note: Matomo versions, browser storage, tracker configuration order, iframe requests, linked duplicate, legal essential-cookie classification, and network behavior were not tested. The suppression of _pk cookies is a maintainer expectation and the original reporter never posted verification results.

scope_note: Release artifacts, Git tags, signing keys, integrity design, production deployment, and current Nextcloud behavior were not inspected. The record does not indicate data sharing, personal-data exposure, or a privacy control; it documents expected limitations of a source checkout.

rationale: 公开 dotfiles 的秘密与可关联身份信息分层处理，讨论模板注入、加密、私库和 commit 元数据泄露。
observation: 用户希望公开可复用的 dotfiles，同时将两类材料隔离：SSH/GPG 私钥、证书等 secret 完全不进入联网版本库；域名、全局 IPv6、用户名、主机与网络配置、Git 作者身份等虽不直接授权，却可能把活动映射到本人。讨论依次探索 public/private 仓库、yadm alternates、Git clean/smudge filter、加密、secret manager、Jinja/envtpl 与 JSON 模板注入，并显式考虑过滤遗漏和 commit 元数据泄露。报告者最终形成模板化方案并提交示例；末条参与者提出把整个 dotfiles 保持私有、只按需另行发布副本，以消除误公开和双版本维护风险。
scope_note: The linked repositories, pull request, documentation, scripts, screenshots, encryption implementation, secret-manager setup, generated files, Git history, and real private deployment were not inspected. observation: 报告者反对 Betaflight Configurator 依赖专有 Google Chrome，认为开源项目不应迫使用户采用其认为不安全/不重视隐私的浏览器，并要求 standalone application。讨论指出现有 Chrome App 带来跨平台收益，命令行可替代，应用也能运行在开源 Chromium，并可从 GitHub 以 unpacked extension 安装；Electron 仍基于 Chromium。维护者不接受 Chrome/Chromium“不安全”的判断，最终共识主要是可在文档提及 Chromium，但没有具体数据收集、已发生泄露、独立客户端或文档变更证据。
scope_note: Browser telemetry, Chrome/Chromium builds and policies, configurator permissions, generated flight data, extension installation, documentation changes, later standalone versions, and actual security were not inspected. The privacy concern is a user trust/platform-choice claim, not evidence that Betaflight or Chrome disclosed specific data. Suggested documentation changes and alternatives are not shown as implemented.

scope_note: Lichess profile fields, team membership visibility, IP processing, consent/defaults, search abuse controls, legal analysis, stalking risk mitigations, code, and current functionality were not inspected. A participant's legal characterization is not a legal determination. The final suggestion does not establish that location collection or search was implemented.

observation: Attribution Reporting API 讨论是否在 conversion report 中标注归因窗口，以提升广告转化分桶准确度，同时用随机报告延迟隐藏 click/conversion 时间。讨论识别出 event-level 报告可关联个人事件，暴露 scheduled/window 信息可能泄露浏览器离线时长和行为；aggregate API 因报告不可绑定个体被认为风险较低。方案探索启动时加入有无界尾的指数噪声、扩大延迟与真实世界调参，但也指出噪声会影响及时投递并可能增强跨 publisher timing join。后续方向改为不加显著随机延迟，aggregate 报告标注 `scheduled_report_time`，并建议 event-level 保持一致，同时承认极端离线场景会新增信息。
scope_note: The linked explainers/issues/source, formal privacy model, final specification, browser implementation, noise parameters, experiments, advertiser data, attacks, and deployments were not inspected. Statements about linkability and sufficient protection are design participants' analyses, including one explicitly framed as personal opinion. The later direction records a design evolution but does not prove event-level scheduled time shipped or that residual leakage was accepted in a final standard.

rationale: MaxMind CCPA 分发变化造成 geolocation 数据库下载故障，属外部许可/依赖适配而非产品隐私控制。
observation: MaxMind 因 CCPA 改变 GeoLite2 分发与许可，停止公开下载并要求账户、distribution key、EULA 接受及定期更新，导致 Plan 新安装无法下载数据库、地理定位失效。这是外部数据供应与许可合规变化引发的功能故障；临时方案为手动放入 GeoIP 数据库，后续版本采用 `GeoLite2-Country.mmdb` 并在 reload 清缓存，用户报告看起来可用。材料没有讨论玩家 IP 的采集、定位精度或隐私选择。
scope_note: MaxMind's notice/EULA, fallback service, accounts, keys, download code, update schedule, database freshness, geolocation inputs and outputs, releases, and current Plan behavior were not inspected. The user's success is self-reported and partly uncertain about caching. No conclusion can be drawn about the privacy of Plan's geolocation processing itself.

scope_note: The referenced breach, browser extension/storage, memory behavior, proposed session cache, trusted-device assumptions, autofill changes, code, releases, and current LessPass were not inspected. rationale: 未接受 banner 时 GTM dataLayer 不存在却被 checkout 无条件调用，导致拒绝追踪即无法完成交易；补丁未证实上游合并。
observation: Magento Commerce 启用 cookie restriction 且用户不点击 banner 的 OK 时，Google Tag Manager 不创建 `window.dataLayer`，但 checkout 后续代码无条件 `push`，导致 shipping 后结账卡在空白中间状态。报告者用条件包装调用并附补丁，另一用户在 2.2.4 EE 复现且感谢补丁；官方随后将 Commerce issue 引导到支持/伙伴门户，没有公开合并或修复结果。隐私选择未接受时不应破坏核心交易功能。
scope_note: The attached patches, custom theme, Magento/GTM code, cookies, checkout network behavior, Commerce support ticket, merge, tests, releases, and current Magento were not inspected. The defect was independently reproduced in-thread, but the workaround and upstream remediation were not verified; official closure reflects routing rather than resolution.

scope_note: The Teams SDK/docs, removal timing, hidden tabs, external applications/data, Feedback request, retention policies, actual deletion failures, code changes, and current Teams behavior were not inspected. scope_note: The referenced Bugzilla/Jira/duplicate issues, videos, URLs, custom-tab implementation, fix patch, tests, release notes, and current Firefox behavior were not inspected. User reports substantiate the failure and disclosure risk, while device/channel reproduction is inconsistent. A developer's fix statement and later non-reproduction do not independently prove which code changed or that all affected releases were fixed.

scope_note: The live site, browser network trace, cookie contents, Ronneby theme, linked support thread, plugins, source code, and current versions were not inspected. The request was observed by the reporter, but causal attribution to Yoast is contradicted by theme-dependent reproduction and the maintainer's denial; the actual source and any remediation remain unknown.

rationale: 仅凭邮箱确认不能证明历史 guest 订单属于同一人，最终决定不关联，优先避免跨客户披露。
observation: Open Food Network 最初拟在用户确认邮箱后，把同邮箱的既有 guest customer 记录关联到新注册账户，让企业看到完整购买史，但不向用户显示 guest 订单。设计者指出邮箱可能拼错、被重新分配或被随意填写，仅凭邮箱无法证明同一自然人；若向新账户展示旧 guest 订单，会泄露前一位订购者的记录。讨论一度主张确认邮箱后合并，也有人强调 guest checkout 未经身份认证、数据不可信。最终决定完全不把旧 guest orders 与新账户关联，接受企业客户列表出现同邮箱的注册/访客重复项，并在后续议题提议加 `guest` 标签以表明不同身份。关闭只表示方案转移到 #2338，不证明 UI 或数据模型改动已实现。
scope_note: The linked epic/issues, screenshots, schema, email-provider reuse policies, existing production association behavior, implementation in #2338, tests, migrations, releases, and current product were not inspected. The thread establishes a design decision to avoid association, but does not prove that a guest label or any supporting code was delivered. Email confirmation authenticates mailbox control at one time, not ownership of historical guest orders.

scope_note: The follow-up issues, AMP consent APIs, postMessage origin/security design, iframe implementations, analytics requests, code, tests, releases, and current AMP were not inspected. observation: ungoogled-chromium 的 Chromecast 支持因 mDNS/Service Discovery 被禁用而失效，同时原报告还夹带 Widevine DRM 问题。讨论澄清 Cast sender 可在本地网络用 mDNS、WebSocket 和 Cast protocol，不一定依赖 Google servers；但重新启用 discovery 会周期性广播，即使 payload 不外传，对不使用此功能且希望系统静默的用户仍是隐私/网络暴露面。贡献者尝试用 chrome flag/命令行参数控制 discovery，提交了未编译的 patch 附件，评审发现 GN flags、广播关闭保证和 C++ 错误，最终没有可验证合并。2020 年用户发现纯 ungoogled build 启用实验性 `cast-media-route-provider` 后可原生投屏，另一参与者独立确认；团队接受将其作为可选功能并关闭议题。因此实际可用路径是用户显式打开已有 flag，而非默认恢复 mDNS 广播或合并早期 patch。
scope_note: The linked issues/patch attachments, packet captures, mDNS payloads and destinations, GN/build flags, Chromecast protocols, Widevine, Chrome Media Router, source code, wiki documentation, releases after 2020, and current ungoogled-chromium were not independently inspected. The artifact contains two user confirmations for the experimental native-provider flag, but no proof that the early privacy-toggle patch was merged or that every platform/build casts without additional network behavior.

rationale: 核心是 Terraform IAM 所有权语义；隐私仅体现在调试配置需私下分享，替代 resource 有用户确认。
observation: Terraform 0.8.4 的 `aws_iam_policy_attachment` 在同一 managed policy 被多个 attachment resources 管理时反复从不同角色移除/恢复关联，导致每次 plan/apply 来回变化。报告者因 debug output 含敏感配置而不愿公开，只愿放 secret gist 或私下邮件；维护者尊重该顾虑并要求最小无秘密复现，随后通过私下材料成功复现。根因是该资源的所有权语义：一个 attachment 管理该 policy 的全部 users/roles/groups，两个同 policy 的 attachment 必然冲突；应保持一对一，或对角色使用 `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment`。后续两名参与者称切换后符合预期/运行良好。这里的隐私只涉及诊断材料披露控制，核心问题是 IAM 资源幂等性与建模语义。
scope_note: The private trace/config, AWS account state, Terraform/provider code, documentation versions, managed-policy semantics in later providers, exact release where role attachment support changed, tests, and current Terraform were not inspected. The thread establishes reproduction and user-confirmed alternative usage, but no product privacy behavior; confidentiality concerns apply only to sharing diagnostic infrastructure data.

observation: Transportr 请求类似 Firefox private browsing 的全局 private querying 模式，在 directions、departures 和 nearby stations 等所有查询路径中阻止历史写入。讨论不仅关注数据库条件判断，还强调功能可发现性、启用状态的持续视觉提示，以及不能让用户误以为搜索网络层也完全匿名；Tor 是另一个议题。两名贡献者曾称存储阻断 setting 已做/正在做并展示 UI 草图，但没有 PR 合并证据。后来维护者因无人继续、预计约 20 小时且缺乏个人动机而关闭；用户认为无法筛除历史是隐私和可用性 showstopper。清空整个 app data 会同时丢失 provider 与 home/work，切换 provider 也只适合临时展示；更灵活的逐条历史删除由仍开放的 #74 优先，最终本条加 `unresolved` 标签。
scope_note: The screenshots, claimed local work, branches/PRs, database tables, all search forms, Tor/panic-button issues, #74/#343, Android storage behavior, releases, and current Transportr were not inspected. Contributor statements and mockups suggest partial local development but no merged implementation. Closure reflects prioritization, and the explicit unresolved label plus open selective-deletion issue contradict any claim of completion.

observation: 共享 Nextcloud 实例的 Mail recipient autocomplete 向用户建议整实例账户邮箱，可能让本应互不可见的用户相互发现。维护者最初说明 collected addresses 应按 current user scope，并怀疑来源可能是 contacts integration；报告者还在 Files share 中看到同样全用户列表，提示 server/config 层问题。另一用户在 NC 11.0.3 与全新 NC 12、Mail 0.6.4 重现，指出查询同时覆盖 `accounts` 与 `mail_collected_addresses`。维护者关联 server PR #4757；NC11 用户回移修改后完全失去 autocomplete 但接受该临时结果，维护者称 NC12 已解决并关闭。后来原报告者在 NC12.0.4/Mail0.7.9、关闭 autocomplete 后再次看到问题，被要求另开 regression ticket。因此存在初次修复和用户临时验证，但同 artifact 也记录了回归，不能声称最终消除。

rationale: Nearby 位置发 Wikidata 与潜在 crash report 位置需要政策说明；登录页 link 有实现声明但数据流未验证。
observation: Wikimedia Commons Android 的 Nearby 会把设备当前位置随附近地点查询发送至 Wikidata，可能意外暴露家庭等敏感位置；提议还要求说明 crash report 未来若包含坐标可能把位置发送给订阅私有邮件列表的核心开发者，并限制开发者仅为改进 app 使用、不再披露个人信息。讨论选择用登录/注册或 About 中的 policy link 告知，而非每次操作弹窗。最初贡献者链接 WMF privacy policy，但维护者因 #891 否决并要求改链 app 自有 wiki draft；2018 年用户观察到 login 页已有 Privacy policy link，维护者确认链接已实现并关闭。因此“入口链接”有实现证据，但最终政策内容、Nearby 请求时即时提示以及 crash-report 坐标规则未在本记录中验证。
scope_note: The Nearby implementation/network payload, Wikidata logs, crash reports, private mailing list, WMF/app privacy policies and #891, PR/commit, screenshots, policy-link target observed in 2018, releases, and current Commons app were not inspected. The thread establishes an implemented link according to maintainers, not that every proposed disclosure/rule was included or that location transmission requires contextual consent.

rationale: iTunes 隐私 API 警报一度定位到错误 cache path，后续相似拒审被用户缩小为其他 library。
observation: 升级 FFImageLoading 2.2.1 后，iTunes Connect 以 app 访问隐私敏感 Photo Library 却缺少 `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` 为由拒绝上传。维护者先否认使用照片库，随后定位到默认缓存路径错误地指向 `../Library` 而非 `../Library/Caches` 并给出修正。2017 年另一用户在 2.2.9 遇到同样拒绝；维护者称最新版已修复且多款应用未被拒，用户升级 2.2.13 后仍失败，最终判断可能由其他 library 触发。因此库的路径 bug 有明确修正声明，但后续类似警报被用户自行缩小为其他依赖，不能把所有 iTunes rejection 归因于 FFImageLoading。
scope_note: The binaries, Info.plist, iTunes static analysis, path semantics, change commit/release, apps deployed by the maintainer, the later user's dependency graph, custom cache behavior, and current FFImageLoading were not inspected. The thread supports a path correction and a later alternate-attribution conclusion, not proof that no version ever triggered privacy API detection.

rationale: 为 usage reports 提议 RAPPOR/差分隐私以降低个体真实性，因复杂度和低敏感判断被拒。
observation: Syncthing 用户因 folder sizes 等 usage reports 即使不可直接关联到身份也属私人信息而系统性关闭上报，认为这造成 opt-in 样本偏差；他提议用 RAPPOR/差分隐私的随机响应，让客户端报告真实或随机值，服务器校正概率看趋势，从而降低单条真实性并提高用户信任和代表性。维护者承认选择性上报造成偏差，但认为现有报告无法关联到具体用户、用户本可拒绝，RAPPOR 对数据敏感度和用例过度复杂；提议者接受其仅为改进建议。记录没有算法实现或 reporting 行为变化。
scope_note: The RAPPOR/design links, actual usage-report fields, identifiers/network metadata, server storage/access, opt-in UI, statistical analysis, code, later telemetry changes, and current Syncthing were not inspected. The noncorrelatability and sensitivity assessments are maintainer claims; the artifact establishes rejection of the differential-privacy proposal, not empirical privacy guarantees.

rationale: Chart.js 在禁 canvas 防指纹时崩溃，PR 修复的是优雅失败而非抗指纹保护本身。
observation: Chart.js 用户指出越来越多人为防 canvas fingerprinting 而禁用 canvas，此时库抛出 JavaScript errors，可能连带阻断其他正常脚本；请求 fallback 或至少提示 canvas 已禁用。维护者同意应优雅处理 canvas 不存在并愿意合并防崩溃 PR，最终明确称由 #3474 修复。该变更是兼容隐私防护工具的错误处理，不是 Chart.js 自身实施 canvas 指纹或反指纹。
scope_note: PR #3474, the original errors, canvas-blocking methods, fallback behavior, tests, release containing the fix, affected integrations, and current Chart.js were not inspected. The thread supplies a maintainer fix reference but no independent user retest; it addresses graceful failure rather than fingerprint resistance.

rationale: Facebook graph 请求确用于 share counts，初始“样式不需要”假设被撤回，但第三方跟踪成本未改变。
observation: Jetpack Sharing 在 Facebook 按钮设为 `Icon + Text` 时仍向 graph.facebook.com 发出三次请求，报告者以为该样式不显示 share counts，因此请求不应运行，并担心第三方 cookie 未阻断时 Facebook 可跨 WordPress 阅读行为跟踪用户；已有 `jetpack_sharing_counts` filter 可作为禁用计数的 workaround。报告者随后自行纠正：所有 button styles 都支持显示 count，只是 count 为 0 时不显示，所以把原 bug premise 判为 invalid。该纠正解释了请求的功能目的，但没有否定外部请求的隐私影响，也没有显示默认行为改变。

scope_note: The library source, wiki/docs, token and user payload contents, XSS and browser threat model, cookie attributes, silent-renew mechanics, versions, linked issue #1176, and current successor library were not inspected. The artifact confirms a configuration pattern and user-reported success, while the PII warning is brief and does not establish the comparative security of either storage mode in every deployment.

observation: Decidim 当前只有“使用 Cookies”的信息警示，却可能为 analytics 跟踪访客；需求要求解释每类 cookie 的用途并允许接受或拒绝，还要求安装者可启用模块、配置目的与必需 cookie。讨论把范围扩展到 localStorage、sessionStorage 等所有设备端存储，并设计四类：强制的 Essential，以及可选的 Preferences、Analytics/statistics、Marketing；未同意相应类别前应禁用功能。由于 iframe 尚不能分类，第一阶段拟在用户同意全部类别前隐藏所有外部 iframe，后续再在 Quill editor 中为 embed 指定类别。参与者称当前 sprint 会做第一部分，但验收框仍未勾选，材料没有 PR、发布或测试，故记录为详细的分阶段设计而非已实现。
scope_note: The linked proposals, libraries, module, screenshots, sprint work, iframe placeholder, code, pull requests, acceptance tests, releases, current Decidim, and legal analysis were not inspected. The first-stage all-iframes rule is explicitly a temporary response to missing categorization and may not represent the eventual behavior.

rationale: 隐私插件与 Otter 性能冲突在 2.0 有用户复测恢复；同时 issue 暴露临时管理员凭据，consent 语义不在范围。
observation: Otter 1.7.5 与 GDPR cookie/policy notice plugins 同时启用时，页面资源越多越慢，客户页面甚至 timeout；报告者分别用 GDPR Cookies plugin 与 OrbitFox Policy Notice 复现，说明问题不限单一 policy plugin。讨论怀疑 policy module 的脚本渲染阻塞，另一参与者把慢点关联到 OrbitFox 调用 `wp_kses`，并称升级 Otter 2.0 后正常。原报告者随后在自身场景确认 Otter 2.0 页面即时加载并关闭 issue，因此有明确的版本修复声明和用户复测；但根因及具体代码未验证。这是隐私政策组件的性能兼容问题，不是 cookie consent 本身的正确性问题。正文还公开了一个仅七天有效的测试站点管理员凭据，属于复现过程中的临时安全敏感信息披露。
scope_note: The linked network captures, test instance, support conversation, plugin code, `wp_kses` execution, fix commit, benchmarks, credential validity, and current versions were not inspected. User confirmation strongly supports recovery in Otter 2.0 for the reproduced setup, but the root cause and breadth across cookie-policy plugins remain uncertain; no conclusion about consent compliance follows from the performance fix.

scope_note: The OWA runtime, cookie inventory, purposes, lifetimes, domains, documentation, legal requirements, versions, warning integration, and current behavior were not inspected. The one-sentence response establishes only that cookies are used.

rationale: VIN 长期云存储因跨法域、维护与自愿上传负担而被放弃；个人云/IoT 仅讨论。
observation: CanZE 提议按 VIN 长期保存电动车电池退化数据并绘图/预测，且希望 clear cache 不删除这些数据；但手机寿命和 factory reset 远短于车辆退化周期，使本地存储不足。讨论认为 cloud storage 会带来 Luxembourg/German legislation、明确自愿上传、额外数据保护、数据库处理许可和长期维护责任，因此倾向放弃 app 内功能；曾探索用户个人 Google Drive、第三方 IoT 服务和 MQTT/WiFi gateway，以避免项目自身承担存储。最终明确不在 CanZE 内实现 degradation function，MQTT 先放到 WiFi gateway 且处于 back burner。这里的结果是因隐私/法律与责任负担而撤回功能，而非实现了云端保护；把数据交给个人或第三方服务也只是一度讨论。
scope_note: The VIN data fields, identifiability, local/cache storage implementation, cited laws, cloud or Google Drive security, OAuth, ThingSpeak/MQTT design, WiFi gateway implementation, website notices, later community work, and current CanZE were not inspected. The final comment clearly rejects the in-app function for stated reasons, but does not rule out later external cloud analysis or prove any alternative's privacy safeguards.

rationale: 调试时公开真实 migration metadata 引发二次披露和第三方工具分享准则争议；技术问题解决不等于治理落地。
observation: Jupiter/ERA issue本来同时核对 License/Rights 标签、creation date、thesis committee metadata 与搜索标签页计数。排查 committee 数据时，参与者刻意不粘贴其余数据以顾及隐私，但随后有人在公开 GitHub 中贴出真实 migration metadata，引发关于第三方公开仓库二次发布个人信息的长篇争议。团队区分两类资料：公开 thesis bibliographic metadata 被认为受用户协议授权，可依原 access rules 复制分发；CCID、登录衍生资料、email 等 account/user data 则被认为高度敏感，不能因在别处可见就随意放进 GitHub、Rollbar 或 analytics。反对者还提出即使法律允许，缺乏必要价值时也应避免扩大可发现性；团队最终建议建立在 GitHub/ZenHub 等第三方工具分享不同资料的内部准则并咨询 FOIP/data-management 专家。结尾声称原始四项 UI/metadata 问题均已解决，但没有明确证明隐私分享准则已制定；technical closure 与 privacy governance outcome 必须分开。
scope_note: The linked ERA records, migration packages, prior issue, user agreement, UofA privacy policy, FOIP interpretation, access settings, internal IST agreements, eventual team guidelines, code, deployment, and current Jupiter were not inspected. Participants disagree about legal and ethical treatment of already-public metadata; the final resolution list addresses the four original interface/data-display questions, not whether a third-party-sharing standard was actually adopted. The retrieved discussion itself also contains an email signature, illustrating but not independently adjudicating the disclosure concern.

The discussion converges on a manual override concept but provides no delivery evidence.

rationale: 后台 heartbeat 使 idle timeout 永不触发；关闭 keepalive 可恢复超时但牺牲 polling，非活动模型修复。
observation: Nextcloud 的 30-second notification polling/heartbeat 会持续刷新 inactivity，导致配置为 30 秒以上的 session timeout 永不触发；用户实测 `session_lifetime=29` 会登出，而 30 或更多不会，并将共享环境中未授权人员接触 unattended laptop 视为重大 security/privacy concern。最终维护者说明设置 `session_keepalive=false` 会停止 notifications polling 与 heartbeat，使 session 能按 inactivity timeout；这是一项现有配置 workaround/solution，而不是修改 idle-time 计算忽略 background requests。材料未含原报告者复测，也未说明关闭 keepalive 的通知功能代价。
scope_note: The linked notification code, session implementation, config defaults, polling intervals, exact timeout semantics, side effects of disabling keepalive, browser/server behavior, user retest, releases, compliance frameworks, and current Nextcloud were not inspected. The final explanation is technically specific, but it does not establish that polling can remain enabled while being excluded from activity or that all deployments will time out as intended.

observation: MetaMask 原行为向访问的每个 site 暴露 selected account，并默认暴露 `web3` API，使站点在用户未主动连接时也能获知账户或识别扩展。目标改为 per-domain deliberate consent：默认不注入 accounts/web3，Dapp 通过不依赖扩展可见性的 `postMessage` 请求连接，用户确认后才显示 account/API，同时尽量兼容旧 Dapps。设计尚需确定 message format、唯一性、扩展参数和 rollout；为了跨 web3 browsers 接收，提案不强制 `targetOrigin`。讨论进一步指出复杂/可复用的选择性披露偏好即使在 consent 后也可能形成跨 Dapp fingerprint；团队认为未同意时完全忽略 request 可消除 nonconsensual MetaMask fingerprinting。迁移计划包括先让高级用户启用 full-web3-stealth-mode，再提供 request-login API，最后 hard break，并向 Dapp developers 公告。2019 年参与者称 #4703 已修复，项目人员又以 connect screen 已实现（参照 #3930）为依据关闭，构成实现声明；但本材料未独立核验账户/API 暴露、message protocol 或所有旧站兼容性。
scope_note: The linked designs/RFCs/issues/commit, actual injected objects, origin validation and spoofing risks, final message format, account permissions storage/revocation, selective-disclosure defaults, rollout releases, legacy-Dapp behavior, connect screen tests, later architecture, and current MetaMask were not inspected. observation: phpVMS 用户担心把 pilot state 改为 `deleted` 后 name/email 仍保留，希望在不破坏 PIREPs、airline stats 等必需关系时匿名化，并一度想让回归用户恢复 progress。维护者解释现有 admin red delete 已按关联数据分支处理：有 PIREPs/ACARS/finance 等记录时替换 name、mail、password、IVAO/VATSIM ID 等 personal data，并让保留记录不可识别/追踪；没有这些记录则直接删除 user。参与者强调 GDPR removal 应不可逆，回归者应当作 new member；发起者理解此前混淆了手工 `state=deleted` 与 delete button 并同意关闭。另有管理员描述自己的 cron 会删除 pilot 及其创建的每条记录，但这是个人部署策略，不是产品保证。材料对既有功能有多方具体声明和用户接受，仍未独立验证字段覆盖、匿名化强度或关联/备份。

The discussion strongly supports an existing conditional deletion/anonymization path, but its technical completeness and GDPR sufficiency remain unverified.

rationale: 长期 persistent cookies 的必要性、session 默认和逐 cookie 期限/consent 设计被接受讨论，但无实现。
observation: ExpressionEngine 默认以 persistent cookie 保存 flash (1 day)、last_activity/last_visit (1 year)、remember (2 weeks)、visitor_consents (1 year)；报告者认为即使标为 Strictly Necessary，也需为各 cookie 证明必要性且说明不可关联 user activity，否则 GDPR 地区应在 active consent 后才写入。EE 当时无法统一缩短 duration，也无法把 creation 绑定 consent，因此提议新安装默认所有 cookie（除 CP 必需）均为 session，长寿命由用户在 consent features 中选择。讨论进一步要求可微调每个 cookie、采用更严格国家标准、默认更隐私并记录匿名拒绝决定。没有代码、版本、测试或发布证据，accepted/closed 只反映需求状态。
scope_note: The cookie-setting code, EE version after issue, CP versus front-end cookies, consent module, jurisdictional legal sources, log schema, migration, defaults, tests, and current ExpressionEngine were not inspected. The issue and comments articulate a compliance design gap but provide no delivery or proof that existing persistent cookies were changed.

scope_note: The runtime/pallet code, membership identifiers, blockchain observability, exchange and mixer privacy, regulatory/security implications, voting currency flow, ZK design, final decision, release, tests, closure reason, and current Joystream were not inspected. The sole comment's claim that an extra purchase step preserves privacy is speculative and does not prove unlinkability.

observation: 报告者给出多种 JavaScript PoC 检测 CanvasBlocker：触发 extension wrapper 自身 exception 且因不同 security context 无法读取 `err.name`，检查 overridden `getImageData.length`，或用异常 `canvas.width=null`/`apply(undefined,...)` 使实现报错。这些差异为 browser fingerprint 增加“是否安装 CanvasBlocker”一 bit。维护者区分可修 extension bug 与 Firefox core prototype/function-length bug：旧 Firefox 45 ESR 支持被放弃，新 Firefox 52 vector 承诺修；测试页后来大多正常，但 `known pixel value test 10` 因 fake canvas 原理可能不可消除，改变 minimum faking size 只会让站点换尺寸。Firefox 59 后参与者称技术问题已解决、未来保持该表现，但 2018 仍有人看到 known-pixel detection。结论是多数实现泄漏有修复声明，结构性可检测性仍存在，closed 不等于完全不可 fingerprint。
scope_note: The linked PoCs/testing page, Firefox bug, extension source/fixes/releases, exact default modes, browser versions, screenshot, entropy in real fingerprinting, known-pixel test mechanics, later WebExtensions behavior, and current CanvasBlocker were not inspected. The discussion supports fixes to several accidental signals but explicitly acknowledges at least one conceptually difficult detection channel; no claim of complete indistinguishability is justified.

observation: Bot Framework 用户处理 PII 并用 custom BotState 指向自有 database，以为可避免任何 Microsoft storage；但 Direct Line `GetMessages` 不调用 BotState 仍能返回消息，暴露出另一条 channel-level 存储路径。维护者解释 BotState 仅存 bot 内部 tracking state，Direct Line 是 store-and-forward service，使用 Azure Table Storage 加密暂存 conversation messages，其他 channels 通常仅 proxy transport/translation。保留期先被不确定地猜为 7 days，随后另一维护者明确为 24 hours；当时不能选择 developer-controlled location/datacenter 或禁用 retention。报告者将此视为 legal showstopper，考虑 custom connector 绕过 framework；项目只将可控存储纳入思考/未来公告，并无实现。

scope_note: The many linked political/privacy sources, GitHub/AWS/Microsoft practices, Tor behavior, alternative hosts, self-hosting costs, federation/email workflows, any later repository migration, and current Firejail governance were not independently inspected. Numerous assertions are advocacy claims rather than verified facts within the artifact; the directly evidenced project decision is to remain on GitHub for community/operational reasons and lock the discussion.

rationale: MaxMind CCPA 政策导致打包下载迁移到 geoipupdate，是外部依赖适配而非 ntopng 用户权利控制。
observation: MaxMind 因 CCPA policy 取消 GeoLite2 免费 direct download，要求用户注册 account 后授权获取，导致 ntopng `gmake geoip` 下载 hostname 失败。用户提供 `geoipupdate` workaround：创建 MaxMind account/token、安装 config 并下载到指定目录；项目随后说明 `ntopng-data` package 改为依赖 `geoipupdate` 而非直接携带 geolocation databases，并新增继续使用 geolocation 的文档。这里 CCPA 是上游分发政策变化背景，修复是 packaging/authenticated-download 适配，不是 ntopng 自身 CCPA 数据权利功能。
scope_note: The MaxMind policy/blog, account terms, download URLs, package/source changes, README, token security, releases, tests, geolocation data processing, and current ntopng were not inspected. The final comment provides concrete packaging/documentation remediation, but it should not be interpreted as a privacy control for ntopng users.

observation: Brave 用户请求内置类似 `I don't care about cookies` 的 cookie-banner blocker，避免以全局 script blocking 破坏网站。项目后来采用 EasyList/Fanboy cookie filter list 路线：adblock-rust 修复及依赖更新被称已合并、将进入下一 Nightly，release note 表述为从 `Prebake Cookie` 切换到 `Easylist Cookie`。桌面可在 `brave://adblock` 启用；Android 当时只应用 network half、不支持 cosmetic rules，iOS 也缺 cosmetic filtering。用户在 macOS 对同一站点先报告失败，启用 `Easylist cookie` 后确认成功，但另一用户仍失败。2022 年 Brave 发布阻止 notices 的说明，同时承认 Google/YouTube 等站点无当前方案；团队明确选择 filter-list approach，因为自动处理式 `I {still} don't care` 路线被认为隐私保护更弱。材料支持功能合并、发布与有限用户复测，也显示跨平台、默认启用状态和站点覆盖并不完整。

observation: Application Insights JS 在 Angular SPA 的 OpenID callback URL 中捕获并发送 `id_token` 与 `access_token`，形成 credential/PII 泄露到 telemetry 的风险。维护者建议使用 telemetry initializer 过滤或改写；报告者实际按 URL path censor 后确认满足主要场景。但 SDK 的 `URL_LONG` diagnostic warning 仍包含被截断的原 URL 和 token 前缀，维护者说明同一 initializer 也可阻止该 warning 被发送，并另开 issue 简化操作。材料支持应用侧过滤 workaround 经用户确认，不支持 SDK 默认安全、自动 token redaction 或后续易用性修复已交付。
scope_note: The linked initializer article/issue #174, SDK defaults, exact telemetry envelopes, token exposure duration/access/retention, warning destination, local console versus remote transmission, URL parsing, built-in sanitizers, later releases, tests, and current Application Insights JS were not inspected. The reporter confirms a manual censoring solution, but responsibility remains with integrator configuration in this record.

scope_note: The package manifest/build artifacts, docs analytics configuration/notice, UA destination, network requests, npm package versions, or current Buefy were not independently inspected. Within the artifact, the reporter's direct correction strongly negates runtime library injection, but it does not assess privacy compliance of the documentation site's analytics.

observation: IE 的 Advanced Privacy Settings 被设为阻止 first-party persistent cookies、只允许 transient/session cookies 时，Sails 的默认 session cookie 不被保存，导致每个 request 新建 session ID 并触发 CSRF mismatch；浏览器仍可能报告 cookies enabled。维护者解释这里的 IE `session cookie` 指关闭浏览器即销毁的 transient cookie，而不是应用意义上的 authenticated session，并建议对受影响请求设置 `req.session.cookie.expires = false`。报告者通过先设 test cookie、结合 IE user agent 只对拒绝持久 cookie 的用户切换 transient expiration，确认 workaround `works great`，避免普通 IE 用户关闭浏览器后丢失 cart。该 artifact 主要是兼容用户浏览器隐私设置的 session/cookie 工程问题，而非个人数据披露；解决位于应用 hook，没有 Sails core patch。

observation: PrestaShop 用 `MAX(number)+1` 生成 invoice number，缺乏 concurrency lock 时两个同时执行的 orders 可取得同一 number；原报告称后一个 customer 因重复号看到另一个 customer 的 invoice，形成跨客户数据泄露与财务编号完整性风险。维护者多次因人工无法复现而关闭并推测 module problem，但多个独立商店报告数年内 7、10、19、94 次甚至 triple duplicates；2023 年参与者通过在 insert 前加入 `sleep()` 给出确定性 race reproduction，并以独立 database sequence 临时修补。另一个报告称其重复 ID 场景中 client data 正确，只是 invoice ID/delivery note 错误，表明后果可能依路径而异。记录持续到 2024 仍有 batch-generation 重复报告，没有官方 core fix、版本或验证。
scope_note: The linked duplicate issues, screenshots, databases, invoice retrieval query that could expose another customer's document, concurrency transactions/locks, module configurations, proposed sequence patch, MySQL/MariaDB variants, financial regulations, official source changes, releases, tests, and current PrestaShop were not inspected. Multiple field reports and a deterministic race technique strongly support duplicate-number risk, while cross-customer disclosure is asserted by the original scenario and not shown for every reported duplicate path; no official resolution is evidenced.

observation: CourtListener 因大量 removal requests 讨论如何平衡公开司法记录、研究/API access、搜索引擎可发现性与当事人的 reputation/privacy harm。团队明确区分 de-indexing 与 deletion：案件继续留在 CourtListener，目标是让 Google 等不再索引。讨论以约 2,000 个既有 blocked cases 分析 unpublished、court、asylum 等特征，并争论关键词/法院/precedential status 的自动规则会保护 asylum seekers、minors、divorcées、drug-war defendants、paternity 与 wrongful-termination parties，还是会过度遮蔽公共利益和权力机构 wrongdoing。最终采用近 30 年范围内的多类 search rules，跳过 bankruptcy、增加 paternity/wrongful termination 等；2021 年先批量使约 400k cases 较难访问，随后考虑从 batch 改为 ingestion-time enforcement，最后维护者明确称 `finally fixed`。这是已执行的大规模 search-engine suppression 与持续规则实现声明，不是删除原始 records，也不保证第三方 search cache 立即移除。

rationale: 额外 profile 字段被以 GDPR accountability 为由拒绝与 auth 共存，责任归属法律理由有争议。
observation: Vert.x MongoAuth 的 API 只接收 username/password/roles/permissions，用户希望再传 JsonObject template 储存 timezone、language、activation status 等 additional fields。早期讨论已接近可提交 PR，并强调 password 必须继续由 auth provider hash/manage、现有 API 保留兼容、冲突字段要明确定义。后来维护者以 GDPR accountability 为由拒绝合并，认为把 personal data 与 auth account 直接关联会使 framework 暴露/承担责任，额外字段应由 application external collection 管理；报告者反驳合规责任应在应用开发者。最终是 `wontfix` 的架构/责任边界决定，不是 GDPR 技术要求已被材料权威证明，也不是数据删除或加密功能。
scope_note: Any associated PR, MongoAuth schema/security, password hashing, external profile patterns, GDPR controller/processor/accountability law, framework liability, later APIs, releases, and current Vert.x Auth were not inspected. The outcome is a maintainer policy decision based on a contested legal rationale, not an authoritative statement that co-locating fields is prohibited by GDPR.

rationale: TLS 1.3 容器支持是一般传输安全/发行版问题，Alpine 有多用户确认但 GDPR 仅背景且无直接个人数据边界。
observation: 官方 docker-nginx images 因 Debian/Alpine 所带 OpenSSL 版本长期无法启用 TLS 1.3。讨论覆盖自编译 OpenSSL 1.1.1 pre-release、LibreSSL/BoringSSL、edge/testing/backports 的安全更新与维护负担、forward secrecy、TLS 1.0/1.1 deprecation，以及等待 stable distributions 的项目政策；GDPR 只被参与者用作强化 cyber-security 的动机，并非 issue 的数据保护功能。Alpine 3.9 image 最终在 2019-02-01 带 OpenSSL 1.1.1a，项目方引用具体 commit 称 Nginx 可运行 TLS 1.3；多名用户确认可用，但 TLSv1.3 不默认启用且需正确 `ssl_protocols`/cipher/default-server 配置。Debian mainline 后续仍滞后，2020 也有人在旧 Alpine-based nginx 1.18 image 中看到 OpenSSL 1.0.2q，说明能力依 image/tag/base distribution 而异。
scope_note: The many linked standards/articles/distribution issues/patches/commit, image manifests and tags, actual TLS handshakes, cipher/security claims, forward-secrecy configurations in TLS 1.2, defaults, Debian/Alpine release timelines, tests, and current nginx images were not independently inspected. The 2019 Alpine support and user confirmations are strong implementation evidence for that image generation, but TLS 1.3 required configuration and was not universal across later/older tags; GDPR references are advocacy context rather than a compliance conclusion.

rationale: PFS 不能阻止服务端记录 query，讨论主要纠正威胁模型；无新的端到端 query encryption。
observation: Searx 用户把 Perfect Forward Secrecy 误解为能阻止恶意 metasearch instance 记录或事后解密查询，并希望中间服务看不到 query 的端到端加密。讨论澄清：PFS 保护已录制的 HTTPS 流量免受单次密钥破解的横向影响，但不能阻止终止连接的 Searx 服务记录明文请求；是否强制 PFS 属 reverse-proxy/instance administrator 配置，并伴随旧浏览器兼容性取舍。参与者称示例 Searx instances 已对全部 cipher 使用 FS、Searx 用 POST 避免 query 出现在 URL，但 browser title 仍可能留历史；SearchEncrypt 的 AES query 参数存于 cookies，既不能令服务器看不到 query，cookies 还可能成为 identifier。最终 maintainer 认为 query encryption/PFS 不构成 Searx 自身 issue，未实现新的端到端加密功能。
scope_note: The linked SearchEncrypt code/privacy notice, SSL Labs results, Searx issues/PR, actual cipher negotiation, cookie rotation, logging configurations, browser-history behavior, and current Searx implementation were not independently inspected. Statements about existing all-cipher FS and POST behavior are participant claims in the thread. No new implementation or test is evidenced here; the issue mainly resolves a threat-model misconception.

observation: Element/Riot 用户长期请求按 room、date range、format 等导出 chat logs，用于个人备份、全文检索、会议归档、迁移及服务器 retention/丢失前保存；有人称其为 GDPR data-portability 要求，但维护者反驳 web client 不存储数据，因此该法律结论在材料中有争议。早期 workaround 包括 matrix-recorder、matrix-dl、matrix-archive 等，常见问题是命令行门槛、E2EE/字符/依赖失效、批量抓取过度以及解密后本地明文存储。项目随后把一次性 web export 纳入 GSoC：设计讨论涵盖 PDF/HTML/plain text、date/message/size limit、attachments 与 progress；持续 append-only desktop logging 明确不在本 issue scope。2021 年出现 export PR，一名用户在 `develop.element.io` 实际成功导出，维护者称会进入下一 release，因此有实现、用户复测和近期发布声明；scope 是 webapp 及继承功能的 desktop，不包括 Android。2023 年又有人担心 encrypted room 导出为未加密副本，提出 encryption option/warning/admin controls；维护者称开放协议无法强制阻止有权限用户导出，相关加密/警示请求被建议另开 ticket，本材料未显示实现。

The thread strongly supports a working development implementation, one user success, and maintainer next-release intent, but not the exact production version or complete behavior. GDPR applicability and later export-encryption/admin-control ideas remain disputed or proposed rather than established compliance or delivered safeguards.

rationale: 多期刊 role self-enrollment 避免跨 journal 管理员代操作，merged PR 有实现声明；consent 法律观点未验证。
observation: OJS multi-journal 用户已在 journal A 注册却未必拥有 journal B 的 author role，点击新投稿只收到无权操作错误，形成反复求助与 submission dead end。讨论从增加 profile/roles link，转向允许进入 submission wizard 并由用户在第一步选择 submitting role；多 journal 可能同属一机构，也可能是不同 controllers/domains，因此参与者担心 manager 跨 journal enrollment、可见他刊 user data 或替用户操作缺少知情同意。团队最终放弃完全自动 enrollment：无 role 时显示可用 author roles；已有或 managerial roles 时显示/预选适当选择，只有用户选择 author role 后才 enrollment，并保留 editor 以 managerial role 投稿的能力。privacy statement 已存在于 submission page；讨论建议 registration 与 submission 时处理明确 consent，避免无必要的重复 checkbox，但这些是设计/合规意见而非法律裁定。PR #3542 被接管并并入 #3575，最终维护者明确称 issue 已在合并 PR 中解决，支持功能已实现。

scope_note: The linked MaxMind materials, licenses/EULA, statutes, actual applicability of CCPA/GDPR, current redistribution terms, conversion script/database provenance, accuracy, existing server geolocation/announcements, data flows, opt-out rights, releases, and current ET: Legacy were not independently inspected. rationale: Monero coinbase decoy 分离提案因 p2pool 改变假设而被报告者判 largely no longer needed，未改 consensus。
observation: Monero proposal 认为 coinbase outputs 与普通 outputs 可区分、公开 mining-pool payout 信息使许多 coinbase decoys heuristically dead，导致普通交易 ring 的 effective anonymity set 被浪费；建议 consensus 强制 coinbase/non-coinbase rings 分离、wallet 分别选 decoys，并对 coinbase funds 提示或执行 churn。讨论的核心 trade-off 是：提高多数 non-coinbase 用户的 plausible decoys，可能同时把 coinbase spends 明确分组、降低 solo/private-pool miners 的 obscurity，增加 consensus complexity/patterns，并依赖当前 mining composition 假设；替代方案包括增大 ringsize、不同 selection algorithm 或 pool outreach。没有形成实施共识。2022 年报告者自己指出 p2pool 使普通矿工可真实花费 coinbase outputs、制造大量噪声，原“绝大多数用户不会花 coinbase”假设已不成立，因 proposal largely no longer needed 而关闭；p2pool 当时仅约 5–10% hashrate，问题被减弱而非宣称完全消失。
scope_note: The linked tools/articles/issues/logs/research, screenshots/data, ring-signature mathematics, heuristic accuracy, pool disclosures, attack models, p2pool adoption/output distribution, wallet/consensus code, later proposals, chain behavior, and current Monero were not independently inspected. Quantitative privacy claims are participant analyses, not reproduced here. Closure explicitly reflects a changed ecosystem assumption and rejection/obsolescence of this proposal, not implementation of ring separation or complete elimination of the heuristic.

scope_note: Discord APIs/events, actual bot data stores/commands, guild versus global presence semantics, search availability, alternative moderation tools, user notice/consent, data retention, later issues/features, code, and current bot were not inspected. The artifact clearly documents rejection of this tracking proposal, not a deployed feature or measured privacy breach.

observation: Ushahidi 原先所有 survey/task fields 都公开，导致从 Facebook 带入的 PII 只能删除或放弃发布。设计先考虑 field-specific roles，后为避免 survey/field permission collisions 简化为 `Make responses private` locking：空白 survey 仍向有 submission permission 的 author 显示该 field 并可填写；提交后 detail/edit/postcard 仅对有权 edit 整个 post 的用户显示，其他用户完全看不到。它控制 visibility，不提供仅编辑部分 post 的 field-level edit permission；Tasks 最初不在快速实现 scope，whole-survey invisibility 也另属其他 issue。QA 在环境中发现 private fields/admin visibility、hide-author 与多项 UI 问题，记录项后来勾选修复；除 private photo 一度仍异常外，tester 称其他 private fields 工作，后又明确“Private fields work perfectly”，开发者称 field level good to go 并因已认可而关闭。故核心 private-field visibility 已实现、QA 并合并，但 photo 路径与完整 task/author/whole-survey scope 不能无限外推。

scope_note: The client incidents, affected emails/data subjects, extension/version compatibility, cited commit/diff, MC-18193, actual release packages, reproduction on vanilla/current versions, other exception paths, tests, notifications/remediation, and current Magento were not independently inspected. The fix is code-supported in discussion but not reporter-verified.

scope_note: All linked issues/PRs/MSC/spec changes, prototype commits, server/client versions, actual network receipts, notification behavior across clients, work after locking, 2022 metadata activity, and current Element were not inspected. Intermediate claims that a flag existed do not override its later removal and lack of a compatible server.

rationale: GDPR/CCPA consent string 解析和 OpenRTB 映射在 Go/Java 均有完成声明，但 enforcement/生态迁移未验证。
observation: Prebid Server/AMP 的同一 `CONSENT_STRING` 可能是 IAB TCF1 GDPR 或四字符 US_PRIVACY/CCPA，原先假设 `gdpr_consent` 总是 GDPR、AMP 会传 `us_privacy` 均不成立。委员会批准的 phased design 要同时接受 `gdpr_consent`/`consent_string` synonyms，按格式严格解析并分别映射到 OpenRTB `user.ext.consent` 或 `regs.ext.us_privacy`，未知格式警告并忽略；之后 AMP key 迁移到 `consent_string`，远期才停止旧 key。讨论澄清该 parsing 与 PBS enforce mode 分离、简化 `consent_state` 被忽略；过程中 PBS-Java 标为 in progress，最终维护者明确称 Go 和 Java 均完成。故是跨两种实现的 consent-string classification/forwarding 功能交付，但并不证明最终 consent enforcement、CMP correctness 或 Phase 2/3 全部外部生态迁移。
scope_note: The linked AMP/PBS PRs, Go/Java code, tests, warning location, releases/deployments, actual CMP strings, enforcement behavior, Phase 2/3 completion, TCF2 support, bidder handling, and current Prebid were not inspected. The final comment is strong implementation evidence for both server variants, but not end-to-end consent compliance.

rationale: telemetry opt-out 后仍加载 GTM并泄露 referrer，cloud call 可关闭但 Google/迁 PostHog 仍未完整解决。
observation: Netdata v1.12.1 用户创建 `.opt-out-from-anonymous-statistics` 后仍加载 Google Tag Manager，并观察 netdata.cloud SSO call；维护者解释 opt-out flag 只让 `anonymous_statistics=false`、阻止 GA tag/host information，而 GTM script request 本身仍发生并携带 browser referrer，cloud call 则属于 sign-in。用户验证配置 `cloud base url` 可停止 netdata.cloud call，但 Google referrer leak 仍在。讨论提出 `Referrer-Policy: same-origin`，参与者称反向代理实测有效；团队担心影响 SSO，只计划提供 configurable header，随后承认不记得做过任何 referrer fix。2020 年团队决定移除 agent 上除 `index.html` 外的 GTM；2021 年旧 Debian package 仍显示 index GTM。团队又称正在测试 self-hosted PostHog、目标是不再把 agent analytics 发给 Google，但只是 next-release proposal。整个 thread 中 default opt-out、index GTM/referrer 与 static analytics争议未消失，最终没有明确 release/fix confirmation；因此有可验证的 cloud-call workaround 和 partial GTM removal decision，但原始“opt-out 后仍对 Google 发请求/暴露 referrer”未被完整解决，PostHog migration 也不能计作完成。
scope_note: Network captures, GTM container behavior, GA/server logs, referrer contents, privacy policy, linked issues/PRs, DO_NOT_TRACK changes, package versions after those stated, Referrer-Policy implementation, SSO effects, PostHog migration/release, current Netdata, and legal/anonymity assertions were not independently inspected. Participant and maintainer claims conflict, so neither zero GA data nor unlawful tracking is treated as established.

rationale: WinGet 已有 machine-wide opt-out 和文档澄清声明；client-local control 转后续 issue。
observation: WinGet release/Store builds启用 diagnostic telemetry，private builds 不启用；最初 README 只提收集而未说明退出方式，引发关于 Home/Pro Windows diagnostic minimum、数据内容、匿名/假名化和 GDPR/CCPA 的长期争论。团队先把控制指向 Windows 10 machine-wide privacy settings，随后承认处理不当，明确称 opt-out 一直存在并更新 docs/README；issue 被重新打开后给出路径 `Settings → Privacy → Diagnostics & feedback`，声称 current client respects machine-wide settings。参与者依据相关 PR 认为设为 Basic 后 winget 不发 telemetry，但材料未直接展示 PR。团队另开 #279 讨论 client 内显式 opt-out，因此本 artifact 证明的是已有 OS-level opt-out 与 documentation clarification，而非 client-local control 已实现；法律及匿名性争议不裁定。
scope_note: The README/PR/#279, emitted events, Windows editions/settings semantics, Diagnostic Data Viewer, identifiers, release binaries, later client-local control, current WinGet, and legal/compliance claims were not independently inspected. Maintainer statements support OS-level control and documentation work but not completion of the separate explicit in-client feature.

observation: Prebid.js User ID module 在 CMP deny-all/尚未回答时仍写 `_pbjs_userid_consent_data`。维护者解释它是 consent string 的 `cyrb53Hash`、30-day first-party cookie，用来检测 consent changes 并刷新/撤回 vendor IDs；团队同意应补文档。法律必要性有争论，随后提出把 read/write 移到 GDPR purpose-1 check 之后并提交 PR #6551。2023 年用户复测 CMP 晚于 PBJS 加载时 cookie 仍被写入，且 null consent 被默认成 `gdprApplies:false`；另有 sharedId storage，除非启用 `strictStorageEnforcement`，否则 core storage writes 不受 GDPR enforcement。最终回复承认可改成 skip writing，但没有新 fix/merge。故最初 PR 是部分/场景受限的 remediation，late-CMP 路径仍残留，不能按 closed 视为完全修复。
scope_note: The sites/CMPs, PR #6551/#8651, code and releases, actual cookie values, browser storage, purpose/vendor consent semantics, strict enforcement defaults, later fixes, current Prebid.js, and legal claims were not independently inspected.
